blocks.h2: Toilet Problems We Fix in Mokena

tiles.body: A worn flapper or fill valve.
A failed wax ring, often from a loose toilet.
An older low-flow model or a problem further down the line.
Loose bolts or a damaged flange.

blocks.intro: Many Mokena homes have several toilets, and a lot of them are original to the house.

items.body: Toilets from the 1990s were among the first low-flow designs, and many clog more often than newer ones.
A toilet below the sewer line drains to an [ejector pump](/mokena/ejector-pump). Clogs there can involve the pump.
A slow leak at an upstairs toilet shows up as a stain on the ceiling below.
If you're replacing vanities or flooring, it's a good time to replace an old toilet and the shutoff valve behind it.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: We tell you whether to fix it or replace it.

steps.body: For the repair or a new toilet.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Toilet Work
blocks.body: Small repairs are quick. Resetting a toilet or replacing a flange takes longer. A new toilet depends on the model. We look first and quote a flat price.

items.q: Why does my toilet keep running?
items.preview: Usually the flapper or fill valve.
items.answer: Usually a worn flapper or a fill valve that doesn't shut off. Both are simple repairs.

items.q: Is it worth replacing an older toilet?
items.preview: If it clogs often or leaks, usually.
items.answer: If it clogs often, cracks or keeps needing repairs, a new toilet is usually the better value and uses less water.

items.q: Why is there water around the base of my toilet?
items.answer: Usually a failed wax ring. If the toilet rocks, the bolts or flange may need repair too.

items.q: Can you install a toilet I bought?
items.answer: Yes. We'll install it with a new wax ring, bolts and supply line.

items.q: Why does my basement toilet flush slowly?
items.preview: It may be the ejector pump, not the toilet.
items.answer: A toilet below the sewer line drains to an ejector pump basin. If the pump is struggling, the toilet drains slowly. We check both.

items.q: How much does toilet repair cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's wrong and whether you're repairing or replacing. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
